content.text: Pherus Health explores what a personal health system looks like when you actually own your own health data, instead of it living scattered across providers you can't fully access.
It's a decentralised approach: your health information stays under your control, built on modern web technologies and open standards rather than a closed proprietary format.
This is still early-stage work. The shape of what Health becomes will keep evolving as the research and the technology mature together.
